evidence: Added explicit math.isfinite(snr) check before threshold comparison; full re-derivation reduced candidate count from 741787 to 741786.

Official Zenodo Table2 archive passed its expected MD5 check. It contains 781602 object rows and 781602 unique explicit Seq values spanning 1..781604; Seq is not a contiguous 1..781602 range, so row ordinals are invalid.
Corrected CPVS identity mapping reads explicit Seq/SourceID and crosswalks Table4 entries by normalized ZTF name; zero published names are missing and no duplicate names were found.

Full source-backed membership result: 741786 candidates, 730184 published members, 730184 intersection, 11602 candidate-only, zero published-only; exact membership under the SNR-only predicate remains false.

Independent metadata-validity diagnostic: requiring positive finite gmag, rmag, Per-g, and Per-r yields exact set equality with published Table4. Candidate-only partition: 11580 fail both metadata pairs, 17 have valid mean magnitudes but incomplete per-band periods, 5 have valid per-band periods but incomplete mean magnitudes. This predicate is diagnostic only; its scientific justification is not explicit in the paper.

Full audit artifact preserves the complete 11602 SourceID/ZTF-name discrepancy ledger and source hashes.

root_causes: Confirmed implementation defect: _snr_from_mag_error returned NaN for invalid errors, while the previous guard only checked snr < sigma; NaN comparisons are false, so invalid-error rows could qualify. The explicit finite-SNR guard removed one candidate.

Confirmed identifier-mapping defect: the pinned CPVS Table2 has an explicit Seq/internal SourceID field, but prior derivation and audit logic used row ordinals. Seq spans 1..781604 for 781602 rows, so row ordinal is not a safe join key. Corrected audit crosswalks Table4 entries by ZTF name.

Strong numerical explanation for the remaining 11602 candidate-only objects: all are excluded by requiring positive finite parent gmag, rmag, Per-g, and Per-r; that filtered candidate set equals the 730184 published members exactly. The source paper does not explicitly state this four-field validity predicate, so the scientific selection rule remains unconfirmed.

The SNR-only predicate admits 11602 extra objects; the nonlinear SNR diagnostic does not change membership, and flag-zero/magnitude-cut variants do not reproduce the reference. No threshold or filter has been accepted merely to force cardinality equality.

findings: Non-finite numeric results must be rejected explicitly before threshold comparisons.
CPVS Table2 Seq is the documented internal identifier joining the catalog to single-exposure photometry; physical row order is not a safe join key.
VizieR Table4's catalog-internal ID must not be assumed equal to Table2 Seq; use a ZTF-name crosswalk.
The corrected full SNR-only run yields 741786 candidates, 730184 published objects, 11602 candidate-only and zero published-only; zero false negatives does not explain the excess candidates.

Positive finite gmag/rmag/Per-g/Per-r reproduces exact published membership, and the 11602 extras are accounted for by incomplete parent fit metadata; however, the publication does not explicitly document this predicate, so exact method reproduction remains unresolved.
Do not change production thresholds or acceptance criteria merely to force count equality.
